title: How Physicists Created a Holographic Wormhole in a Quantum Computer
summary: Quanta Magazine explains the 2022 experiment that claimed to create a holographic wormhole on Google's quantum computer. The description now notes that a later independent analysis questioned whether any wormhole was created.
why: Initially praised as a nicely done explainer, it is now more often cited as an example of overhyped quantum coverage.
